en.text:
Hits inflict increased Flinch on Enemies.

<pve/>PVE: <link Tier 1-2 Minors [#CombatantClassifications] /> can be repeatedly staggered. Higher Tier Combatants stagger quicker.

<pvp/>PVP: Flinch against Players varies based on damage and Weapon Archetype. Flinch increase ranges between 5-10%.
